what: Pressing a work card lifts the portrait image frame inside the card into a fixed-position layer, which flies and grows over .5s cubic-bezier(.83,0,.17,1) to the large image slot on the detail page (16px below the header · left margin + 16px · half-column width). Meanwhile the body fades out and swaps via swup (.3s). Once the new page has fully arrived, the image in that slot fades in over .2s and the floating layer disappears .2s later — a handoff that stitches the same image from list to detail

options.[data-fx-part=frame]: Frame for the flying image (child) — moves its first child (the image) onto the panel. The link style variable (background tone) is also moved onto the panel
options.--fx-tone: Panel background (before the image comes in), default var(--kf-surface)
options.hold: Time (ms) until the previous panel is cleared after fx:land, default 200
options.fx:navigate · fx:land: On press, fx:navigate from the element { href, clone } comes up — block it and hand over with swup.navigate(href), then when the new page stands, fire fx:land on document. If not blocked, it goes to that address after the flight

from.where: index.html .hj-project (work card → detail.html large image, together with a swup 4.3.4 transition)

shared.js beginHero·heroEnter (the center video in the first Hero floats up during the swup transition to the detail stage size — 1s power3.out · .3s delay · the inner window margin clip opens with it · the caption is lifted along too)

note: The original moved the image element itself to the layer — here we move a clone and empty the frame (restored when revived from the back-button cache). The original CSS has a reverse flight on close (pageImageClose), but no script uses it so it is not included
